mapper.insert:

)VALUES( #{cameraId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{upRegionId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{fileName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{filePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{absoluteFilePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )

update t_record_file a a.end_time = #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, a.file_path = #{filePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, a.absolute_file_path = #{absoluteFilePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR},
where a.file_name= #{fileName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT a.camera_id, a.channel_num, a.camera_type, b.preset_id, b.preset_num, c.record_id, c.record_ip, c.identity_manager, c.identity_code, c.rtsp_port, a.camera_ip, a.port, a.infread_port, a.camera_manager, a.camera_code, a.camera_num, a.up_region_id FROM t_camera_info a LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset b ON a.camera_id = b.camera_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_recorder c ON a.record_id = c.record_id WHERE 1 = 1 and a.camera_id = #{cameraId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and b.preset_id = #{presetId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1

#{cameraId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
SELECT a.record_id, a.record_name, a.record_ip, a.protocol, a.http_port, a.trans_port, a.rtsp_port, a.identity_manager, a.identity_code, a.max_channel FROM t_camera_recorder a
SELECT a.channel_num, a.camera_id FROM t_camera_info a LEFT JOIN t_camera_recorder c ON a.record_id = c.record_id WHERE 1 = 1 and c.record_id = #{recordId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT a.record_id AS Id, a.record_name AS label, "-1" As upId, "null" As upName, "record" AS infoType, "-1" as channel_num FROM t_camera_recorder a UNION ALL ( SELECT b.camera_id AS Id, b.camera_name AS label, b.record_id AS upId, c.record_name AS upName, "camera" AS infoType, b.channel_num FROM t_camera_info b LEFT JOIN t_camera_recorder c ON b.record_id = c.record_id where 1=1 and b.camera_name like CONCAT('%',#{cameraName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') )

select a.robot_id, a.robot_code, a.robot_name, a.robot_status, a.robot_type, a.robot_ip, a.robot_port, a.light_ip, a.light_port, a.identity_manager, a.identity_code, a.lnferad_IP, a.Inferad_Port, a.Inferad_username, a.Inferad_password, a.phote_path, a.create_by, a.create_date, a.update_by, a.update_date, a.robot_factory, a.is_use, a.commission_date, a.up_region_id, a.robot_position, a.remarks, a.record_id, a.channel_num_light as numLight, a.channel_num_inferad as numInferad from t_robot_info a where 1 = 1 and a.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1

select a.record_id, a.record_name, a.record_ip, a.protocol, a.http_port, a.trans_port, a.rtsp_port, a.identity_manager, a.identity_code, a.max_channel from t_camera_recorder a where 1 = 1 and a.record_id = #{recordId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1
